aboutDetail:
An independent music client built with MyGo.
Music and accounts are provided by YouTube Music.

Global play / pause: ⌘ / Ctrl + Shift + Space
Closing the window keeps music playing; press ⌘ / Ctrl + Q to quit.

signOutMessage: Sign out and clear local account data?
signOutDetail:
Playback stops, the sign-in window closes, and ytmgo clears every account's sign-in state, cookies, web storage and cache on this device.
Your appearance and language settings and your cloud library are kept. Other browsers stay signed in.

nativeEmptyResults: No music found. Try another search.
nativeLibraryHint: Sign in to see your YouTube Music library.
nativeAccountGuide:
1. Open the extension folder.
2. Copy the Brave extensions address and paste it into Brave’s address bar. Enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select that folder.
3. Open YouTube Music and select your account. Open ytmgo Account in Brave, confirm the account, then click Connect account.
nativeAccountPrivacy: ytmgo verifies membership with YouTube and remembers this session in the system secret store. Signing out here leaves Brave signed in.
nativeAccountWaiting: Waiting for your explicit account transfer from Brave. This window accepts one transfer for five minutes.
nativeAccountChecking: Verifying the account and configuring playback…
nativeAccountExpired: The connection window expired. Choose Retry to open a new five-minute window.
nativeAccountBridgeError: Could not open the local account connection. Close any other ytmgo login window and retry.
nativeAccountStorageError: Could not access the system secret store. Allow ytmgo access, then retry. No unencrypted session will be saved.
nativeAccountBrowserError: Could not open Brave. Install or open Brave Browser, then retry.
nativeAccountAddressCopied: Copied brave://extensions/. Paste it into Brave’s address bar and press Return.
nativeAccountClipboardError: Could not copy the address. Enter brave://extensions/ in Brave’s address bar.
nativeVerificationHelp: ytmgo cannot complete this verification in the app. Open YouTube Music in Brave. If the website asks for verification, follow its instructions, then return here and retry.
nativeConsentHelp: YouTube redirected this request to a consent page. Open YouTube Music in Brave, review any consent request on the website, then return here and retry.
nativeServiceSignInHelp: YouTube redirected this request to sign-in. Open YouTube Music in Brave and follow any sign-in request on the website, then return here and retry.
nativeRecoveryLimits: Browser steps may not unblock this app request. If retry still fails, try again later.
nativeRecoverySignInHint: You can also try signing in to ytmgo, but signing in does not guarantee that this restriction will be removed.
nativeRecoveryConnectedHint: Your account is still connected. This restriction does not establish that your session or membership has expired.
nativeServiceRedirect: YouTube returned a page redirect that ytmgo cannot handle
nativeServiceRedirectHelp: YouTube redirected this request to another page. ytmgo cannot confirm whether verification or another browser step is needed. Open YouTube Music in Brave, follow any website instructions, then return here and retry.
nativeRecoveryConnectionHint: This account connection has not completed. Retrying will reopen the browser account transfer; your existing account, if any, will be kept.
